@syntax Global name[type] [= value][, name2[type] ...]
Declares a variable that the main program and every function see. Variables made without a declaration inside a function are local to it. A global can only be declared in the main program, and it is 0 or an empty text until you assign it.

```blitzbasic
;run
Global total = 0

Function Add(n)
	total = total + n
End Function

Add(2)
Add(3)
Print total
```

```text
5
```
